question: Should Telegram suppress these system and compaction notices at the outbound adapter, or preserve the documented notifyUser contract and require a typed, narrower suppression marker?
rationale: The PR changes a visible channel-delivery policy and an existing documented config contract, so automation cannot choose the permanent suppression boundary safely.

options.title: Preserve NotifyUser Contract
options.body: Remove unconditional compaction-notice suppression and only suppress a typed Telegram-specific internal notice class with regression coverage.

options.title: Change Telegram Notice Policy
options.body: Intentionally suppress all Telegram compaction/system notices, but update docs, tests, and release-note context to make the compatibility break explicit.

options.title: Pause Or Close Direction
options.body: Leave the branch unmerged until the unwanted notice being fixed is demonstrated with real Telegram proof and a narrower policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Preserve NotifyUser Contract
recommendation.body: Remove unconditional compaction-notice suppression and only suppress a typed Telegram-specific internal notice class with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the related compaction-delivery repair and is the strongest available routing signal for the delivery-policy decision.
